description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing jobs, assets, analysis, and reports in a brand compliance analysis backend. It uses FastAPI to provide routes for creating, deleting, uploading assets, analyzing jobs, fetching previews, fixing assets, and downloading reports. It interacts with job state, storage workspace, and several service classes for analysis, fixing, reporting, and error handling.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting job creation with optional metadata fields.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Model for returning created job ID.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model for reporting job status and progress.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Model for request to fix a specific asset.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Model for request to run fixes across multiple assets.

classes.name: PageEntry
classes.description: Model representing a page preview entry with detection info and URLs.
